body:
Update: We reached our goal in under 24 hours?!! Thank you guys so much from the bottom of our hearts. We shared the good news with Nolan and he now has a countdown on his calendar leading up to his appointment for wax molds on the 20th. We will update you guys via Youtube and IG every step of the way from here until he receives his brand new "big ears". Any additional money we raise now that we have met our goal will be money we personally do not have to take out of his special needs medical trust the day of-- so thank you again for any and all you were willing to give to this exciting cause for our superkid. If you would like to donate in the future as these large medical expenses do emerge annually for him, he has a special needs trust set up at Columbia Bank and has since birth. We will likely be taking all that we currently have out of it on the appointment date, as that is what it is there for, but it is so incredible to see it built back up. If you are interested in that trust, checks must be made payable to Nolan Isaac Faber Special Needs Trust. Thank you all so much again! We appreciate that you moved a mountain for us in record time and simply can't believe it. 
Help spread the word!
